summary: The evidence for case 1 (gpu-raw-events-bd1, job 61885491) holds together, and every stated claim matches the embedded artifacts. The checkout HEAD is detached at the anchor SHA. The scheduler capture has 35 rows, all COMPLETED 0:0, on nid200404. The parent job ran 01:07:51 against a 04:00:00 limit on lcls_g/gpu_interactive. The rows break down as parent, interactive and extern plus steps .0 through .31: 4 placement probes, then 2 correctness samples and 12 A/B samples, each run as a warmup step and a measured step. The pair order is balanced. Every sample shows 10000 events, 335571760000 bytes and the same event digest. Every sample has both cache observations at zero, the same placement and contract/profile/correctness digests, and a fixed runtime digest for each side. HNI RX is at least 0.9 of the selected bytes in every sample. I recomputed the paired loop changes from loop_seconds and they match: the mean is -11.6604% and the 95% t-interval is [-30.04, +6.72]. INCONCLUSIVE is the correct label: the interval spans 0 and its upper end exceeds +5%. Pass applies to execution-evidence integrity only. It is not GPU 1 BD performance acceptance, PR acceptance or merge readiness.

findings.evidence: The two large candidate-favoring pairs (2: -36.07%, 5: -32.06%) both have slow baseline samples (loop 277.3s, 314.4s) with elevated HNI cxi rx (401.6 GB, 423.5 GB) and NIC rx/tx, compared with about 347-360 GB in typical samples. Pair 4 is slow on both sides (295.6s/299.5s, about 412 GB rx each). The variability is therefore present in both versions and tracks extra network receive traffic, not the runtime revision.
